R4D-bear-backcountry-0003.name: By Freeze Creek
R4D-bear-backcountry-0003.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R4D-bear-backcountry-0003.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: Burn from 2017 (fire N51265), right here: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
SW facing slope, 19 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Freeze Creek 110 m SE: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: bag 2; private land only, with landowner permission

plan: Drive: from Village of Nakusp, about 105 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 23, Hwy 31, Beaton Armstrong Lake Rd, Fish River Rd.
Park: 50.96734, -117.62637, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 11 km N, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 1,152 m, about 336 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 500 m W of the spot at 799 m (51.06306, -117.58957). Water: Incomappleux River 70 m W (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-33, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R4D-bear-backcountry-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 4-33: about 117 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.05 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
